title: The Last Greenhouse
logline: A botanist must decide whether destroying the last terrestrial tree will save her colony or kill her.
central_conflict: A botanist must decide whether destroying the last terrestrial tree will save her colony or kill her.
theme: A well-meant attempt to help carries a cost that forces a more difficult choice.

characters.name: Mara
characters.personality: Resourceful, emotionally invested, prepared to risk a clear cost.
characters.desire: Diagnose the last tree without sacrificing the colony.
characters.flaw: She treats preserving the last forest as a promise she cannot break.
characters.voice_direction: Natural and specific; composed intent turns to alarm through the consequences.

characters.name: Habitat
characters.personality: A distinct counterpart with a practical objective, not a generic warning voice.
characters.desire: Keep the colony alive under a rapidly shrinking oxygen budget.
characters.flaw: Trusts procedure or immediate appearances before testing the implication.
characters.voice_direction: Clearly different timbre; measured, then personally unsettled by evidence.

environments.description: A botanist must decide whether destroying the last terrestrial tree will save her colony or kill her. A readable, original setting with visible cause and effect.

grow_lights.statement: The tree is under full grow lights in a lunar greenhouse.

central.question: Why is the tree sustaining Mara, and what would burning it do to her?
central.writer_only_answer: The seed was engineered as a living respiratory graft for the original expedition. Mara inherited the graft; restoring photosynthesis requires separating an emergency symbiosis safely.

season_arc.goal: Diagnose the last tree without sacrificing the colony.
season_arc.conflict: A botanist must decide whether destroying the last terrestrial tree will save her colony or kill her.
season_arc.turn: It is not merely mirroring Mara; Habitat claims it is breathing for her.
season_arc.payoff: The first method fails and exposes the larger problem.

season_arc.goal: Keep Mara breathing while restoring enough oxygen for the colony.
season_arc.conflict: Habitat can sever the respiratory graft, but the emergency procedure may kill the last tree and its irreplaceable seed.
season_arc.turn: A founder medical record links Mara inherited respiratory condition to the experimental seed stock.
season_arc.payoff: A temporary closed-loop mask buys time but confirms that a simple incineration order was never safe.

season_arc.goal: Separate the emergency graft without sacrificing the forest or colony.
season_arc.conflict: The only available growth chamber must be converted into a respiratory bypass, ending Mara promise to keep the original tree intact.
season_arc.turn: The seed was designed as a living respiratory graft; Mara inherited a dependence the colony medical records concealed.
season_arc.payoff: Mara accepts the loss of the original tree to preserve its viable cuttings and sustain the people; Habitat must expose the hidden experiment.
